lines.trans: So, did you have a good time?
Yes, our lunch was really great.
What did he want to talk to you about?
He wanted to get to know me.
Nothing more professional or secret?
He really appreciates my direct frankness.
And afterwards, what happened?
We ended up in the restrooms!
What? That is not possible!
Look at your face, I am only joking!
You scared me so much!
He simply listens to my useful advice.
That is excellent news for you.
Now, I am taking a short nap!

examples.text: Samuel a oublié de vous apprendre la ténacité.
examples.trans: Samuel forgot to teach you tenacity.
I appreciate this generous gesture very much.

examples.text: Tout le monde apprécie son travail.
Après, elles ne peuvent plus s'arrêter.
On mange, et après on part.
examples.trans: We eat, and afterwards we leave.

examples.text: À mon avis, c'est une bonne idée.
examples.trans: In my opinion, it's a good idea.

meanings.note: un avis de décès = a death notice / obituary
à mon avis = in my opinion

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

meanings.note: as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

meanings.en: to know a person or place
ne rien connaître à = to know nothing about

meanings.note: dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.en: direct; live (en direct = live on air)

examples.trans: You're having lunch with Dany Boon.
Shall we have lunch at noon?

meanings.note: also alone as an exclamation: Excellent!
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

examples.text: J'ai vraiment fini par adorer ce contrôle fiscal!
examples.trans: I've really grown to love this tax audit!

meanings.en: to end up doing (finir par + infinitive)

examples.trans: I have always loved your frankness.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille

meanings.en: en ce moment = at the moment, currently

meanings.note: ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
oui ou non? = yes or no?

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

meanings.note: avoir peur = to be afraid; avoir peur de = to be afraid of
pronounced plys when it means 'more' at the end
c'est pas possible! = I can't believe it!

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.
Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.

meanings.note: alone, in surprise or when you didn't hear; a bit blunt
in a sentence with ne: je ne sais rien
rigoler bien = to have a good laugh

examples.text: Mathias rigole toujours avec tout le monde!
examples.trans: Mathias is always joking around with everyone!
It will stay our little secret.

meanings.note: faire une sieste = to take a nap

examples.text: Ce serait super si vous pouviez venir.
examples.trans: It would be great if you could come.

meanings.note: before the verb; t' before a vowel
c'est tellement stupide = it's so stupid
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi
usually plural: les toilettes = the restroom

examples.trans: I am going to the restroom.

meanings.note: informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
same form in masculine and feminine
+ noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
écoute = listen, look (to start a point)
